generated_cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)
// Companies that operate in a publishing‑related industry
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:operatesIn]->(i:Industry)
WHERE toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'publishing'
// Companies that have had Nancy McKinstry as CEO at some point
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:hasCEO]->(p:Person)

      'nancy mckinstry' IN [x IN p.aliases | toLower(x)]
WITH c, (i IS NOT NULL) AS inPublishing, (p IS NOT NULL) AS hadNancy
WHERE inPublishing OR hadNancy
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS companyCount
